metadata.name: Ironhold Prison
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A maximum-security prison on a rocky island at night. In Breakout the Inmates start locked in a three-tier cell block and the doors release eight seconds in; the Guards start in their barracks beside the armoury. Galleries and bridges ring the atrium round a hanging control booth whose lever locks the whole block down. Around it: the laundry, workshop, mess hall and kitchen, a loading dock with a truck, a buggy and a gate, the warden's office and vault, glass-walled visitation, the infirmary, dark solitary, a chapel, a razor-wired exercise yard with a court and bleachers, and sewer tunnels under the yard. Guard towers with turrets and sentries watch from the wall. Hostage Rescue: spring the four held in solitary, the infirmary and the warden's office to the dock or the pump room.

do.text: Ironhold Prison. Lights on: the cell doors release in 8 s.
The cell doors are open. Breakout!
LOCKDOWN! Every cell door is closing...
The control booth lever is reset.
Someone has the LMG from the armoury.
